top_signals.title: Elon Musk blames Indian 'oligarchs' for stalling Starlink launch
top_signals.summary: Space X founder Elon Musk accused oligarchs in India of keeping Starlink out of the country to protect their monopoly over consumers.

top_signals.title: Hackers hijack Google domains after breaching ccTLD registries
top_signals.summary: Hackers obtained unauthorized HTTPS certificates for several Google domains and hijacked domains in the country-code top-level domains (ccTLDs) for Ghana, American Samoa, and Sierra Leone after compromising third-party operators and modifying authoritative DNS records. [...]
